title: Sterling Breeze #604
meta_description: Sterling Breeze #604: Beachfront condo with Gulf views, balcony, pool, and steps to Pier Park.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Sterling Breeze #604, your beachfront escape on the sugar-white sands of Panama City Beach. From sunrise coffee to sunset cocktails, this condo's private balcony gives you uninterrupted Gulf views with the sea breeze as your backdrop.

Inside, the open-concept living space feels bright and inviting, with a dining table for seven, a fully equipped kitchen, and comfortable seating that makes gathering easy. Three bedrooms provide restful retreats for up to six guests, including two ensuite bedrooms---one with a king bed and one with a double---and a cozy bunk room perfect for kids. Three bathrooms, including two walk-in showers and a shower/tub combo, add convenience for groups.

Beyond your door, Sterling Breeze offers everything you need for a fun-filled coastal getaway. Lounge by the beachfront pool, soak in the hot tub, or head to the fitness center or recreational room to stay active. A convenient on-site store keeps essentials close at hand, while a private boardwalk puts you right on the sand within moments.

When you're ready to explore, Pier Park's shopping, dining, and entertainment are just a short walk away, while local attractions like Gulf World Marine Park, Shipwreck Island Waterpark, and 30A's scenic communities are all within easy reach.

Whether you're here for a family trip, a couples' retreat, or simply to relax by the ocean, Sterling Breeze #604 sets the stage for an unforgettable Panama City Beach escape.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A Pack 'n Play is available upon request.

Parking Details:
- Paid parking is available at $50, with a maximum of 2 garage spots. Parking is on a first-come, first-served basis.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
